title: Integrated Bioinformatics and Structural Assessment Suggest Doxycycline as a Potential Candidate Targeting MMP7 in Lung Cancer and SSc-Associated ILD.
authors: Dasgupta, Sanjukta; Ghosh, Moupiya; Sadhukhan, Sukhendu; Set, Srijit
journal: Omics : a journal of integrative biology
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过生物信息学分析肺癌与SSc-ILD共享基因及调控网络，并用分子对接初步评估多西环素与MMP7结合，但核心是疾病转录组与药物重定位，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制研究，仅含简单对接，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Lung cancer (LC), particularly lung adenocarcinoma, is a leading cause of cancer-related mortality, while systemic sclerosis-associated interstitial lung disease (SSc-ILD) is a chronic fibrotic autoimmune disorder. Growing evidence suggests shared molecular mechanisms between these conditions, although their genetic overlap remains insufficiently characterized. In this study, integrative bioinformatics approaches were applied to identify common differentially expressed genes (DEGs) and regulatory networks linking LC and SSc-ILD. Comparative transcriptomic analysis revealed 72 shared DEGs, including 10 hub genes: MMP7, CXCL14, and CD79A (upregulated), and CXCR2, IL1A, FCAR, GRIA1, IL1R2, CSF3, and FFAR2 (downregulated). Regulatory network analysis identified key miRNAs (hsa-miR-34a-5p, hsa-miR-126-3p, hsa-miR-335-5p) and central transcription factors (FOS, JUN, NFKB1). Pathway enrichment highlighted interleukin-10 signaling as a critical shared pathway, implicating immune regulation and extracellular matrix remodeling. Molecular docking suggested a potential interaction between doxycycline and MMP7 (binding affinity -6.4 kcal/mol), while X-ray diffraction and Rietveld refinement confirmed its crystalline purity. Additionally, doxycycline demonstrated antibacterial activity against Staphylococcus aureus via minimum inhibitory concentration assays. Overall, these findings provide preliminary insights into shared molecular features between LC and SSc-ILD and suggest doxycycline as a potential repurposed candidate warranting further experimental and clinical validation.
abstract_zh: 肺癌（LC），尤其是肺腺癌，是癌症相关死亡的主要原因，而系统性硬化症相关间质性肺病（SSc-ILD）则是一种慢性纤维化自身免疫性疾病。越来越多的证据表明，这两种疾病之间存在共享的分子机制，尽管其遗传重叠尚未得到充分表征。在本研究中，采用整合生物信息学方法，以识别连接LC和SSc-ILD的共同差异表达基因（DEGs）及调控网络。比较转录组分析揭示了72个共享DEGs，其中包括10个枢纽基因：MMP7、CXCL14和CD79A（上调），以及CXCR2、IL1A、FCAR、GRIA1、IL1R2、CSF3和FFAR2（下调）。调控网络分析识别出关键miRNAs（hsa-miR-34a-5p、hsa-miR-126-3p、hsa-miR-335-5p）和核心转录因子（FOS、JUN、NFKB1）。通路富集分析强调白细胞介素-10信号传导为关键共享通路，涉及免疫调节和细胞外基质重塑。分子对接提示多西环素与MMP7之间存在潜在相互作用（结合亲和力-6.4 kcal/mol），而X射线衍射和Rietveld精修确认了其结晶纯度。此外，通过最低抑菌浓度测定，多西环素对金黄色葡萄球菌表现出抗菌活性。总体而言，这些发现为LC和SSc-ILD之间的共享分子特征提供了初步见解，并提示多西环素作为潜在的重定位候选药物，值得进一步的实验和临床验证。
